stories.title: Big Ten officially bans NFL players from return
stories.summary: The Big Ten has passed a rule that stops players returning from the NFL from playing for one of its schools.

stories.title: Bengals star Chase 'fine' after knee injury scare
stories.summary: Bengals star Ja'Marr Chase says he is "fine" after an injury scare at practice in which the WR appeared to injure his left knee.

stories.title: York pinged fake prostitute 3 times before arrest
stories.summary: 49ers owner Jed York used a pseudonym and responded multiple times to a fictitious ad for a prostitute prior to his arrest in Ohio over the weekend.

stories.title: Kiffin pushes back on eligibility double standard
stories.summary: Lane Kiffin said that the SEC and Big Ten are using a moralistic double standard by allowing certain players with court orders to play while attempting to ban others.

stories.title: Kubiak mum on details, but Jeanty 'on the mend'
stories.summary: Asked Tuesday about the severity of Ashton Jeanty's injury and if the second-year player will begin the season on the injured reserve, coach Klint Kubiak simply said, "He's on the mend."
